verdict.rationale: Postman docs confirm shared workspaces for teams to collaborate on collections (share, version, discuss work), role/permission controls, and real-time live sessions, supporting the core story. However, community evidence notes a long-standing complaint about lack of seamless live collection sharing without export/import friction, and other threads describe cloud-sync reliability concerns (e.g., lost workspace data after account issues). missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that shared workspace sync works smoothly at scale, and resolution of the noted collection-sharing/export friction complaint.
